data.title: Real use case: Crunched reviews specialist Excel models
data.summary: A named customer describes model review and financial modeling built on Claude, with important product-specific capabilities.

facts.text: Crunched describes an Excel analyst product using Claude with its own context retrieval and finance-specific checks for linking, logic and methodology errors. The source is a vendor/customer account, not an independent Sintra evaluation.

sources.title: Crunched: Excel modeling for investors and advisors

prerequisites: To evaluate a similar pattern: an authorized model and reviewer-labeled errors.
steps: Read the customer story and separate Claude capabilities from Crunched's proprietary layer.
Choose a small model review with known issues.
Compare the candidate output with expert labels and record misses and false alarms.
data.output: A scoped evaluation design for specialist model review.
validation: Measure identified errors, false alarms and review time on the same model.
limitations: Reported benefits and older model names are historical source claims; they are not current model recommendations or reproduced ROI.
